name: Noob Saibot
creator: kaizen
description:
Bringing back one of my old mods, thanks to the ease of use of Divine's modding tools!

This is an up-to-date version of Zed Saibot, swapping Zed's model and voice for that of Noob Saibot. 

### **Disclaimer!**
This is, by all means, still a very old mod of mine. It's jank and it's pretty ugly (but I did update the textures). So don't expect anything special! But people asked me for it so here it is.
